_comment: Battle AI phase 1 (#584) showcase: three unit-leader decisions issued as real queue orders, with no direct target_enemy write. (1) The AI spearmen (anti_cavalry) on the left forms the anti-cavalry square on its own as player cavalry closes -- no player key press arms it, unlike the player-driven anti-cav-square.json demo. (2) The AI infantry on the right advances and attacks the player infantry it's assigned (the advance/attack fallback, now a real ATTACK order) while a second player unit is walked onto its flank; the AI leader reacts by re-facing onto the flanker. Deterministic (scenario + seed + scripted input). The map keeps the default forest but leaves off the hill: the second player Cavalry troop is staged where the hill's south-west corner stands, and the clip is about AI decisions, not terrain.

follow_error.reason: follow_error, the relational successor of shape_residual, reads uid1 25.85 against 6.75 on this tree (dense 2-tick FULL dump, Windows, seed 0, measured 2026-11-13); the slot-based shape_residual this exemption was written against read 25.8. This exemption covers uid 1 only. uid 1 (team 1's 140-strong spearmen block): the AI's ATTACK order re-targets it from enemy uid 0 to uid 2 between ticks 300 and 330, and that order's re-square re-slots the block onto a freshly-rotated grid before its first reform has settled: uid 1's grid is still walking onto its second, freshly-rotated set of target slots at every sample tick from 330 through the end of the clip, so the best-fit rigid-transform residual against the (already-superseded) prior orientation stays large the whole time (measured worst 29.26 wu against the 6.75 wu threshold, at ~tick 420). It is genuinely converging (in a dense local dump, own_slot_dist_med falls from ~78.5 wu at tick 310 to ~0.38 wu by tick 720; the sampled ticks show the same descent), just too slowly for a 140-man block to settle within this clip's length once the AI's mid-march re-target restarted the reform. Measured 2026-09-08 (issue #1544). Uids 2, 3 and 4, which the earlier exemption also named, read 1.76, 27 and 10.4 on seed 0 and, on seeds 1 to 4, 1.76 to 7.21 (uid 2), 4.41 to 15.4 (uid 3) and 10.4 (uid 4), all under their thresholds (13.5, 30 and 13.5), so they are no longer exempt.
